elements_selected.content: Add stratified sampling to the candidate pool in search_chunks_contextual. Currently pool_size = limit * 5 and all candidates come from search_chunks ranked by sim*decay. Change to: (1) Fetch larger raw pool (limit * 8) via search_chunks. (2) Group candidates by source_type. (3) Reserve floor(pool_size / num_active_types) slots per type (minimum min_type_slots candidates per type, if available). (4) Fill remaining pool slots by global score ranking from leftover candidates. (5) Apply mode multipliers to this type-diverse pool (rest of pipeline unchanged). Add config key [mode] min_type_slots (default 2) as the minimum reserved slots per source type. If a type has fewer candidates than min_type_slots, take all of them. This is a surgical change to the pool assembly — everything downstream (mode multipliers, diversity assembly, session tracking) stays the same.
